english.note: Use 又 when applying a previous point to another case or saying that something is also true.

exampleSentences.english: He has to go to work, and I have to go to work again as well.

english.note: Use 又 for an additional parallel property or action, often in a repeated or paired pattern.

exampleSentences.english: They are fast and also clever.
